Return ONLY a single Python code fence with the class definition, no explanation.

from solution import SlidingWindowRateLimiter

def test_allows_up_to_max_requests_in_window():
    limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(max_requests=3, window_seconds=10)
    assert limiter.allow(0.0) is True
    assert limiter.allow(1.0) is True
    assert limiter.allow(2.0) is True
    assert limiter.allow(3.0) is False

def test_old_requests_fall_out_of_window():
    limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(max_requests=2, window_seconds=5)
    assert limiter.allow(0.0) is True
    assert limiter.allow(1.0) is True
    assert limiter.allow(2.0) is False   # still within window of both
    assert limiter.allow(6.0) is True    # the t=0.0 request has aged out
